address: 119-1 Jingshan Road, Shilin District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: On the outskirts of Taipei city sits this zen-inspired restaurant-cum-cultural space embracing food, tea, landscaping and creative arts. The chef shops for the freshest local produce daily and offers two set menus with Japanese and Western courses that honour a vegan and zen ethos. Items can be tailored to diners’ liking in terms of ingredients and portion sizes. Lush greenery adds to the overall experience.
